messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating rollout 2026-03-15T05:12Z: service=inference-api image=infra/inference:release-2026-03b. Canary=15%. Env change: REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID set to key 9876-rotated (rotation window).

maya: getting startup failures on canary group. Errors show kms:GenerateDataKey failed. Logs: see below. :siren:

sam: drop the snippet

maya:```
2026-03-15T05:14:01Z ERROR com.redwood.infer.KeyLoader - Unable to generate data key: OperationDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-svc-role is not authorized to perform: kms:GenerateDataKey on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/9876-rotated
at com.redwood.infer.KeyLoader.load(KeyLoader.java:45)
...
```

ryan: paging oncall. incident-bot, page infra oncall and mark Sev2.

incident-bot: @ryan infra oncall notified (phone/sms). Incident channel created: INC-2026-0315-02.

ryan: I'm on. quick recaps?

maya: canary pods crashloop because they can't decrypt/generate data keys for model env. Looks like the rotation created a new key but the key grant set doesn't include our assumed role. This affects only canary traffic (15%) right now.

sam: checked key grants; the rotation created a new key without the previous grants. The rotation process uses a cross-account key template and we forgot to copy grants for service role.

alice: CS: two customers reported elevated 500s; Tickets: CS-7124, CS-7125. Both routed to canary. No broad impact yet.

ryan: immediate mitigation: 1) pause rollout 2) flip kill-switch for canary traffic 3) apply temporary grant to key that allows kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt to inference-svc-role 4) resume at lower % only after verification.

maya: pausing rollout. deploy-bot: pause rollout 2026-03b.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused. New canary pods will be prevented from receiving traffic.

sam: applying grant via AWS CLI (using kms create-grant to avoid altering key policy):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id 9876-rotated --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-svc-role --operations GenerateDataKey Decrypt
```
Note: grant will auto-expire on key schedule; we will also update rotation automation to copy grants.

sam: grant created, id=gr-0a1b2c. AWS responded success.

maya: restarting a single canary pod to validate.

deploy-bot: pod inference-api-canary-7 restarted (manual).

maya: pod starts, key operations succeed. No crypto errors now.

alice: CS update: CS-7124/7125 now report success. One customer wants a timeline for SLA impact.

ryan: good. Next: don't resume full rollout. Steps: 1) keep rollout paused; 2) flip internal canary toggle to off to ensure no accidental traffic; 3) run a 10-minute smoke test with a single instance; 4) update rotation runbook to preserve grants and to run a post-rotation simulation verifying GenerateDataKey as the service principal.

sam: feature toggle set: admin-console -> inference.canary.routing = OFF. Confirmed.

maya: smoke run executed against restarted canary, 12 minutes, no errors, metrics look normal.

ryan: create followups: (A) infra-ops#555 - make rotation tool preserve grants and optionally mirror key policy. (B) infra-ops#556 - add automated decrypt simulation in rotation pipeline. (C) security#298 - review KMS grant expiration behavior.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-02 recorded: Sev2, partial customer impact, service degraded for canary-routed customers.

alice: drafting customer-facing message: brief outage window 05:12Z-05:28Z, affected customers (2 reported), mitigation steps taken. Will share draft in 30m.

sam: opened PR with runbook updates: infra/ops#1428. Includes CLI snippets and a pre-rotation dry-run described above.

maya: moving monitoring to tom for the next 30 minutes. I'll annotate logs with the grant id for traceability.

ryan: oncall handoff to tom in 25m. I'll prepare the incident timeline and link to logs/metrics. Also confirm there was no key material exposure — only failures.

tom: acknowledged, joining thread.

maya: note for postmortem: include exact create-grant command output, the k8s pod restart IDs, and the canary percentage timeline. Also include a validation checklist for future rotations.

alice: customer comms ready for review.

ryan: closing immediate actions; will convert to postmortem doc INC-2026-0315-02 and ensure remediation tickets are tracked. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-02 moved to postmortem queue. :white_check_mark:

maya: final: no data leaked, root cause = rotation process omitted grant replication for service role. Remediation: update rotation tooling + add simulation + maintain grant audit.

alice: uploading final summary to #eng-postmortems and notifying CS to close tickets when customers confirm.

ryan: good work everyone.
